findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Command injection via shell execution
 * @description Executing shell commands with untrusted input can lead to command injection
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/click-command-injection
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-078
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // os.system calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("system").getACall() or
    // subprocess with shell=True
    call = API::moduleImport("subprocess").getMember(["call", "run", "Popen", "check_call", "check_output"]).getACall() and
    exists(DataFlow::Node shell_arg |
      shell_arg = call.getArgByName("shell") and
      shell_arg.asExpr().(BooleanLiteral).booleanValue() = true
    ) or
    // os.popen calls
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("popen").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe shell command execution that could allow command injection."
findings.hypothesis: Command injection via subprocess calls with shell=True or os.system with untrusted input

message.text: Potentially unsafe shell command execution that could allow command injection.
Potentially unsafe shell command execution that could allow command injection.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Path traversal in file operations
 * @description Using user-controlled input to construct file paths can allow path traversal attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/click-path-traversal
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-022
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["open", "remove", "unlink", "rmdir", "mkdir", "makedirs"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("path").getMember(["join", "exists", "isfile", "isdir"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("pathlib").getMember("Path").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("open").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shutil").getMember(["copy", "copy2", "copytree", "move", "rmtree"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("glob").getMember(["glob", "iglob"]).getACall()
  ) and
  exists(call.getArg(0))
select call, "File operation that may be vulnerable to path traversal if user input is not validated."
findings.hypothesis: Path traversal vulnerabilities in file path handling where user input is used to construct file paths without proper validation

/**
 * @name Insecure file permissions
 * @description Creating files with overly permissive permissions can expose sensitive data
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/click-insecure-permissions
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-732
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    // os.chmod with overly permissive modes
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("chmod").getACall() or
    // os.open with mode argument
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember("open").getACall() or
    // os.mkdir/makedirs with mode argument
    call = API::moduleImport("os").getMember(["mkdir", "makedirs"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "File operation that may set insecure permissions."
findings.hypothesis: Check for file operations that may set insecure permissions

/**
 * @name Information disclosure through exceptions
 * @description Exception handling that may expose sensitive information
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/click-info-disclosure
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-209
 *        external/cwe/cwe-532
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("stderr").getMember("write").getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("sys").getMember("stdout").getMember("write").getACall() or
    call = API::builtin("print").getACall()
  ) and
  exists(Raise r | r.getScope() = call.getScope())
select call, "Potential information disclosure through error messages or output."
findings.hypothesis: Information disclosure through exception messages or error handling that may expose sensitive data

/**
 * @name Server-side request forgery via URL operations
 * @description Using user-controlled URLs without validation may allow SSRF attacks
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/click-ssrf
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-918
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("request").getMember(["urlopen", "urlretrieve", "Request"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("urllib").getMember("parse").getMember(["urlparse", "urljoin"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("webbrowser").getMember(["open", "open_new", "open_new_tab"]).getACall()
  )
select call, "URL operation that may be vulnerable to SSRF if user input is not validated."
findings.hypothesis: Server-side request forgery through URL operations with user-controlled input
